project_type: Django web application with SQLite/PostgreSQL, static files, WhiteNoise, Vercel deployment
build_system: pip + requirements.txt, WhiteNoise for static files, build_files.sh for Vercel
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'python manage.py check --deploy' to validate Django configuration, 2. Run tests with 'python manage.py test', 3. Check admin interface loads without errors at /admin/, 4. Verify static files serve correctly
snapshot_or_generated_files: staticfiles/ directory generated by collectstatic, migrations generated by makemigrations, __pycache__ files. Commands: python manage.py collectstatic, python manage.py makemigrations
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell environment, virtual environment at .venv/, SQLite database at db.sqlite3, do not modify existing migrations
contribution_requirements: Fix security warnings, maintain existing functionality, ensure admin interface works, preserve all existing data models and relationships
key_patterns: Django ModelAdmin with custom list_display and search_fields, middleware with process_request/process_response, context processors for global template data, model methods for business logic
directory_structure: projectshub/ (main Django project), core/ (main app with models/views/admin), templates/ (HTML templates), static/ (CSS/JS/images), staticfiles/ (collected static files), media/ (user uploads), core/tests/ (test files), core/migrations/ (database migrations)
